description.zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1。
description.en: Page number from which the returned results start to be displayed. Minimum value: 1.

description.zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
ID of the edge instance. You can obtain the ID by hovering the mouse over the name of the target edge instance on the **Edge Instances** page in the [edge computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain the ID.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: Instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances. Pass it for Enterprise instances.

description.zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大取值30，最小取值1，默认取值是10。
description.en: Number of records displayed per page in the returned results. Maximum value: 30. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10.

title.zh: 分页查询边缘实例中的场景规则
title.en: Paged query of scene rules in an edge instance

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Condition  
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send up to 10 queries per second (QPS) to this API.  

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
